Son of the sea. Hero of two camps.

Percy Jackson is Rick Riordan’s sharp-witted demigod hero—a New York kid pulled into a hidden world where Greek myths are alive, dangerous, and usually holding a grudge.

Who is Percy?

A spoiler-light introduction to the central character.

Perseus “Percy” Jackson begins the story at twelve, unaware that his father is Poseidon and that the monsters from Greek mythology are real.

After reaching Camp Half-Blood, Percy learns that he is a Greek demigod: half mortal, half god. He becomes the counselor of Poseidon’s cabin and later plays a major role in both Percy Jackson and the Olympians and The Heroes of Olympus. The books are known for telling myth-sized adventures through Percy’s funny, impatient, deeply loyal point of view.

What defines him?

Not raw power alone. Percy’s strongest pattern is choosing people over glory—even when that loyalty makes the quest harder.

Powers & equipment

Poseidon’s gifts meet years of quest experience.

Water control

Percy can manipulate water and becomes stronger, more alert, and quicker to recover when immersed in it.

Underwater survival

He can breathe, see, stay dry, and withstand pressure underwater—making the sea feel more like home than danger.

Riptide

His celestial bronze sword, Anaklusmos, usually hides as a pen and returns to him after it is lost.

Sea-born connection

He can communicate with horses and many sea creatures, and has an instinctive feel for ships and navigation.

Percy’s relationship guide

A closer look at trust, conflict, and loyalty around Percy.

This guide stays light on endings, but it does describe how relationships develop across the original series and The Heroes of Olympus.

Friends

3 close allies

Annabeth Chase

Percy’s sharpest strategic partner and the person most likely to challenge a reckless plan before helping him survive it.

Connection
Shared quests build deep trust from a prickly first meeting.
Friction
Her careful planning often collides with his instinct to act first.
Why it lasts
Each recognizes the other’s courage, loyalty, and blind spots.

Grover Underwood

Percy’s first guide into the mythological world, best friend, and emotional compass when a quest starts pulling the group apart.

Connection
Grover protects Percy before Percy even knows he needs protection.
Friction
Grover’s fears and Percy’s impatience can strain their teamwork.
Why it lasts
Their empathy link turns friendship into a literal lifeline.

Rachel Elizabeth Dare

A clear-sighted mortal who can see through the Mist and helps Percy navigate dangers that confuse most humans.

Connection
Rachel offers Percy a link to ordinary mortal life.
Friction
Her closeness with Percy creates tension inside the larger friend group.
Why it lasts
She chooses her own path while remaining a trusted ally.

Brother

Family by Poseidon

Tyson

Percy’s Cyclops half-brother is gentle, brave, and a gifted builder—very different from the monsters Percy expects to fight.

Connection
They share Poseidon as a father and grow into a genuine brotherhood.
Friction
Percy initially feels embarrassed by Tyson and has to confront that prejudice.
Why it matters
Tyson teaches Percy that character—not appearance or species—defines family.

Enemies

2 major threats

Kronos

The Titan lord is the central threat behind the original series, working through dreams, resentment, and divided loyalties.

Goal
Overthrow Olympus and restore the Titans to power.
Pressure point
He exploits demigods who feel abandoned by their divine parents.
Percy’s answer
Build trust among allies instead of treating power as a solo contest.

Luke Castellan

A talented older camper who begins as a mentor, then becomes Percy’s most personal and complicated opponent.

Connection
Luke teaches Percy swordplay and understands the anger young demigods carry.
Conflict
He turns that anger against the gods and sides with Kronos.
Complication
Percy must oppose Luke without ignoring the real failures that shaped him.

Frenemies & uneasy allies

2 shifting bonds

Clarisse La Rue

A fierce daughter of Ares who bullies Percy early on, competes with him constantly, and still stands beside camp when it counts.

Connection
Both are powerful fighters who care deeply about Camp Half-Blood.
Friction
Pride, rivalry, and very different leadership styles keep them clashing.
Common ground
Mutual courage turns open hostility into hard-earned respect.

Nico di Angelo

A son of Hades whose grief and secrecy make his connection with Percy tense, distant, and eventually more trusting.

Connection
Both understand the loneliness of carrying a powerful parent’s name.
Friction
Nico blames Percy for a devastating loss and keeps dangerous secrets.
Common ground
Shared battles gradually replace suspicion with respect and alliance.

The mythic world

Ancient powers hiding inside modern America.

Riordan’s world treats mythology as a living force that follows the “heart of the West.” Olympus sits above Manhattan; monsters re-form after defeat; and the Mist bends what mortals think they see. Quests turn diners, highways, schools, and tourist landmarks into stages for old myths.

Camp Half-BloodLong Island refuge for Greek demigods
Mount OlympusThe gods’ stronghold above Manhattan
The UnderworldHades’ realm—and never an easy return trip

The Mist

A magical veil that disguises mythological events from most mortals.

Cabins

Campers live and train with siblings who share the same divine parent.

Prophecies

Oracles predict the shape of events—but their wording is rarely kind or complete.

Monsters

Defeating one usually sends it to Tartarus; it may eventually reform and return.

Major story threads

Hidden until you choose to reveal them.

Covers the original five books.

  • Luke becomes the vessel for Kronos, turning a personal betrayal into the center of the Titan war.
  • Percy takes on the Curse of Achilles before the Battle of Manhattan, gaining near-invulnerability at enormous risk.
  • The Great Prophecy is fulfilled through Percy’s final choice to trust Luke, who turns against Kronos.
  • Instead of accepting immortality, Percy asks the gods to claim and care for all their demigod children.

From page to screen

Two different live-action interpretations.

FEATURE FILMS • 2010 & 2013

The film series

Logan Lerman played an older version of Percy in The Lightning Thief and Sea of Monsters. The films compress and change major book events.

DISNEY+ SERIES • 2023–

Percy Jackson and the Olympians

Walker Scobell plays Percy, with Leah Sava Jeffries as Annabeth and Aryan Simhadri as Grover. The series begins with a season-long adaptation of The Lightning Thief.

Demigod glossary

Useful terms before your first quest.

Demigod
A child of one mortal and one god; “half-blood” means the same thing in this world.
Celestial bronze
A magical metal used in demigod weapons. It can harm mythological beings but normally passes through ordinary mortals.
Ambrosia & nectar
Food and drink of the gods. In small amounts they heal demigods; too much is dangerous.
Oracle
A source of prophecy. At Camp Half-Blood, quests begin only after the Oracle gives a cryptic warning.
Tartarus
The deepest region of the Underworld and a place where defeated monsters reform.
